findings.text: the new helper _review_record_directory_grant re-derives the "<runs>/<run>/review-records/<file>" recognition rule that reckon/crew/recovery_review_delivery.py:84 (_delivered_record_location, anchored at reckon/crew/review.py:2477) already implements, so two spellings of one shape rule now exist and a layout change must be made in both; the grant computation itself is new.

the done_when names a ruff check on the changed Python files, but the manifest records no ruff log among test_logs, so the clause is claimed and not recorded; I re-ran ruff 0.16.4 on both files at f912c7ec against the repository config and it passes, so the claim is true but unbacked in the run directory.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit f912c7ec5 against base 78dedec57; it adds _review_record_directory_grant (reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:1852), wires it into _sandbox_reachability (line 1818) and adds a 104-line test file, 134 insertions and 1 deletion, all inside the declared write paths.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_run_review_with_run_directory_records_dispatches.py plus tests/test_a_run_review_cannot_remove_a_siblings_record.py and a ruff check on the changed Python files; head.log records 10 passed EXIT=0 across the two test files and an independent ruff 0.16.4 run at f912c7ec passed, though no ruff log is stored.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to make the dispatch scope check grant a review node the run review-records paths the fence already grants; reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:1818 adds those directories to the reachable roots for a review node before the scoped-finding scan.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the source manifest; status complete, it names commit f912c7ec58aa, the two changed paths, the head and negative-control logs, and the pre-change baseline (2 failed, 1 passed).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/_backends.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py, tests/test_a_run_review_with_run_directory_records_dispatches.py, an evidence fragment and a figures directory; the diff touches only dispatch_admission.py and the new test, leaving _backends.py and the docs artifacts unwritten.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_run_review_with_run_directory_records_dispatches.py:68 fails when the grant is disabled (negative_control.log, EXIT=1) and :86 fails if the helper over-grants another run's non-record path, so the guard reddens on the regression it was added to catch.
justifications.evidence: head.log records 10 passed EXIT=0 for the named tests and negative_control.log records the declared mutation red at EXIT=1, but the done_when's ruff clause is claimed in the manifest with no log stored.
justifications.fit: the private helper at reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:1852 follows the module's helper idiom and introduces no plan label or version in its name or the test filename.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:1818 adds the review-records directories to the reachable roots for role=="review" before the scoped-finding loop at 1839.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:1852 re-derives the review-record shape predicate already owned by reckon/crew/recovery_review_delivery.py:84 (_delivered_record_location, anchored at reckon/crew/review.py:2477) instead of extending it, though the grant computation itself is new.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff changes only reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py and the new test file, a strict subset of the declared write paths, touching neither reckon/_backends.py nor any fragment.
